mapper.sql: jii.journal_indexing_info_id as "journalIndexingInfoId", jii.rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", erv.version_code as "versionCode", erv.version_status as "versionStatus", jii.issn as "issn", jii.journal_name as "journalName", jii.indexing_type as "indexingType", case jii.indexing_type when 'KCI' then '등재지' when 'CANDIDATE' then '후보지' when 'INTERNATIONAL' then '국제등재' else '기타' end as "indexingTypeName", jii.publication_country as "publicationCountry", jii.valid_start_date as "validStartDate", jii.valid_end_date as "validEndDate", jii.source_name as "sourceName", jii.source_updated_at as "sourceUpdatedAt", jii.active_yn as "activeYn", jii.change_reason as "changeReason", jii.updated_by as "updatedBy", jii.updated_at as "updatedAt"
from journal_indexing_infos jii inner join evaluation_rule_versions erv on erv.rule_version_id = jii.rule_version_id

where.if: and (jii.issn ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or jii.journal_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or jii.indexing_type ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or jii.publication_country ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or jii.source_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: insert into journal_indexing_infos (rule_version_id, issn, journal_name, indexing_type, publication_country, valid_start_date, valid_end_date, source_name, source_updated_at, active_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{request.ruleVersionId}, #{request.issn}, #{request.journalName}, #{request.indexingType}, #{request.publicationCountry}, #{request.validStartDate}, #{request.validEndDate}, #{request.sourceName}, #{request.sourceUpdatedAt}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (rule_version_id, issn, valid_start_date, valid_end_date) do update set journal_name = EXCLUDED.journal_name, indexing_type = EXCLUDED.indexing_type, publication_country = EXCLUDED.publication_country, source_name = EXCLUDED.source_name, source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at, active_yn = EXCLUDED.active_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
